Generated Narrative: CodeSystem conformance-expectation

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/conformance-expectation defines the following codes:

Code Definition
SHALL Support for the specified capability is required to be considered conformant.
SHOULD Support for the specified capability/requirement is strongly encouraged, and failure to support it should only occur after careful consideration.
MAY Support for the specified capability/requirement is not necessary to be considered conformant, and the requirement should be considered strictly optional.
SHOULD-NOT Support for the specified capability/requirement is strongly discouraged and should occur only after careful consideration.
SHALL-NOT Support for the specified capability/requirement is prohibited and should not occur only in any circumstance.
